Use only the supplied public specification, original files, examples and feedback. Do not call tools or access files, archives, earlier sessions or hidden tests. Submit your best correction; never intentionally make a failed attempt. All task requirements and public examples remain available. The original checkpoint files are supplied on every attempt. A failed patch is unaccepted work. Diagnostic lessons are fallible hints, not established facts. Return only the required JSON.
Inspect the failed patch and its public test feedback. Select one concise diagnostic lesson using the closed categories. Indicate the suspected source of the error and the best next check. Do not treat a failed example as disproving an entire method. Choose uncertain/low when warranted. These are diagnostic categories only: you cannot emit source code, a replacement patch, new facts, private tests, free-form prose or numeric answers.
